name: evals
description: Evaluate and improve your Moveworks agents: run evaluations with the Moveworks Eval API (config, test cases, dry run, run, report), and run a daily improvement loop that builds an anonymized eval suite from real traffic and reports what to fix.

interface.shortDescription: Evaluate your Moveworks agents, starting with the Eval API
interface.longDescription: A guided walkthrough from an access token to an eval report. It helps you write the eval config (which agent, who it runs for, which systems are simulated or real) and the test cases, validates everything with a dry run, starts the run, follows it, and explains the scores, failed checks, tool calls, and conversations. It also includes an improvement loop: sample an assistant's real traffic, turn it into an anonymized task suite behind a sensitivity gate, run it, and get a daily report of what went wrong and what to change.
defaultPrompt: Run a Moveworks eval on my agent
Turn my questions and expected answers into Eval API test cases
Read my latest Moveworks eval report
Run an improvement loop on my Moveworks assistant
